title: The User App Extension
description: Fields that only the user app uses. The user app OWNS this file. The platform repo owns only the registration in 02-contracts/extensions/registry.json, and enforces this file by its sha256 hash.

id.description: A copy of the Firestore document id. The user app's feedback object is a round-trip shape, so the id has to survive a write and a read.

reason.description: The citizen's free text about the missed collection. Optional.

timestamp.description: When the citizen gave the feedback.

syncStatus.description: The user app's own sync bookkeeping. It is a hint for the app's UI, not a fact about the collection.

x-rules.additionsOnly: An extension may only ADD a field. It may never change a core field's type or meaning.
x-rules.notRequired: An extension may not add a required field. A required field changes the shape for every reader.
x-rules.collectionKeyIsSingular: The key under extends is the schema file's base name, singular. trip, not trips.
x-rules.bumpVersion: Bump extensionVersion when this file changes, then ask the platform owner to re-register the hash.
